instructions: Items a reviewer should look at. Nothing here blocks the site going live. Each item states what was observed, what is missing, the official source used, and what would close it.

rows.title: The five submitted links do not encode an ASIN
rows.observed: Each submitted link is a 9-character opaque token such as B04G1MEwY. An Amazon ASIN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier. The token therefore cannot be read as an ASIN, and none of the five tokens matches the ASIN its link actually resolves to.
rows.missing: The submitter's intended product record for each link.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Confirm the intended ASIN for each link inside the enrolled Associates workflow and record it separately from the observed redirect target.

rows.title: Disclosure wording and endorsement context have not been reviewed by a qualified reviewer
rows.observed: A disclosure strip sits directly under the masthead on every generated page and is repeated in the footer. Every outbound product link carries rel sponsored. The wording has not been reviewed against the Operating Agreement or the FTC Endorsement Guides by anyone other than the author.
rows.missing: A dated, named compliance review of the live pages.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: A recorded review of the published pages against the three official sources, naming the reviewer and the date.

rows.title: Tracking tag propagation through the supplied short links was not observed
rows.observed: Resolving the five submitted short links on 2026-11-20 produced Amazon product URLs carrying session-scoped parameters (lv, btn_type, btn_ref, channelId, plpRedirect). No tag parameter appeared in the resolved URLs. This is an observation about the redirect, not a finding that the links are invalid or non-compliant; their exact status is unresolved.
rows.missing: An Associates click-report check confirming whether a click on each short link is attributed to the tracking ID.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: One click test per product, then a look at the Associates click report.

rows.title: Eligibility and commission rate for the five ASINs is unknown
rows.observed: The listings are live Amazon.com product pages. Nothing has established whether the account is approved for them, whether these specific ASINs are commission-eligible, or what rate applies to each category.
rows.missing: Account approval state, per-ASIN eligibility, and the applicable category rate.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Read the account's Commission Income Statement and check per-ASIN eligibility in the account.

rows.title: The ThermoMaven listing is sold by a third-party storefront, not by Amazon
rows.observed: The B0DHZTCNR5 listing shows the seller as ThermoMaven-US. The storefront carries an Earns Commissions badge and the page also lists an Amazon.com offer on the same item.
rows.missing: Confirmation of which offer the tracking ID attributes, and whether price or availability differs between offers.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: A click test that records which offer the reader lands on.

rows.title: Full specifications, dimensions and care instructions are not yet verified
rows.observed: Only the attributes stated in the official listing titles are currently verified. External dimensions, weight, wattage, temperature range, clearance requirements, dishwasher guidance and warranty terms have not been read from manufacturer documentation.
rows.missing: Manufacturer product pages and user guides for each exact model.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Read the manufacturer documentation and record the document URL and revision date against each attribute.

rows.title: Prices, ratings and review counts are point-in-time observations
rows.observed: Every price, rating and review count on this site was read from an Amazon listing page on 2026-11-20 and is labelled with that date. Nothing on the site describes price history, price stability or likely future pricing.
rows.missing: A second dated capture for comparison.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: A repeatable dated capture procedure and a second observation.

rows.title: No revenue, commission or conversion figure exists for this site
rows.observed: The campaign ledger is empty by design. No click count, session count, order count, commission or forecast has been observed or is published.
rows.missing: An authorised first-party analytics endpoint and the account's own commission report.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Provision the endpoint, implement the five defined events, and enter conversion rows only from a dated Associates report.

rows.title: No analytics endpoint, Search Console property or reader feedback loop exists
rows.observed: The measurement plan defines five events and no endpoint has been provisioned. GitHub Pages serves static files, so a durable collector needs separate hosting.
rows.missing: A hosted collector, a consent banner, a published privacy notice and a retention rule.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Provision the endpoint and publish the privacy notice before any event fires.

rows.title: Working titles are editorial hypotheses, not measured demand
rows.observed: Guide titles describe the question a reader might ask. No search volume, trend data or ranking position is claimed anywhere on the site.
rows.missing: First-party query data from Search Console and the site's own analytics.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Run the site, collect queries, and choose the next topic from the report.

rows.title: The Product Advertising API 5.0 is deprecated; the Creators API is the supported path
rows.observed: Amazon's PA-API 5 documentation URL now resolves to the PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice, which states that PA-API 5 has been deprecated, that continuing calls receive HTTP 403 with an AccessDeniedException, and that the Creators API is the supported successor.
rows.missing: Creators API credentials and a working integration.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Apply for access, read the introduction and migration guides, and prove one ASIN lookup.

rows.title: No product photography is published
rows.observed: The site uses typographic product cards. No Amazon-hosted image is hotlinked or stored.
rows.missing: A decision on the Creators API image service and a reading of the image use rules.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Read the image rules in the IP License section, then decide.

rows.title: The canonical host is derived from the repository name and must be confirmed
rows.observed: Canonical URLs, the sitemap and the feed all use the Pages host https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/WinB/ because the repository is named WinB. The GitHub Pages API reports the site as built and public at that address.
rows.missing: A decision to keep the repository name or to attach a custom domain, plus a re-point of canonical URLs if it changes.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Confirm the host and, if a custom domain is added, rebuild with the new canonical base URL.

rows.title: No product-specific performance claim has been made because nothing was tested
rows.observed: Every guide states what a reader should check rather than which model wins. The site makes no claim about which of the five products is better at anything.
rows.missing: A documented evaluation rubric and either hands-on results or manufacturer specifications for each named product.
rows.whatWouldCloseIt: Write the rubric, gather the evidence, and cite each claim.
